title: Восторг гостя и поручение Нагиева  (The Guest's Delight and Nagiyev's Task)

segments.t: Nastya happily reports to Max that the vegetarian guest was thrilled with his rolls, making Max smirk that any vegetarian dish tastes better with meat. Meanwhile, Nagiyev spots a man photographing him in the dining room and orders Senya and Fedya to scare the paparazzo away.
Гость в восторге от твоих вегетарианских рулетиков.
Ведь любое вегетарианское блюдо вкуснее с мясом.
Знали, что у нас с Кристиной проблемы.
Now let's go back through the conversation line by line.

'Max, you did such a great job.' Even though Kristina did such a great job, Max keeps a steady face in front of Kristina. Speaking with the close, informal "you" strips away any polite distance between them.
Гость в восторге от твоих вегетарианских рулетиков.
'The guest is thrilled with your vegetarian rolls.' Admitting that the guest is thrilled with Kristina's vegetarian rolls shows Nagiyev being honest for a change.
'Well, I should think so.' Saying that she should think is how Kristina sets the tone with Max.
Ведь любое вегетарианское блюдо вкуснее с мясом.
'After all, any vegetarian dish tastes better with meat.' Once after all any vegetarian dish tastes better with meat, Max can finally tell Kristina what he means.
'And do you know what.' Adding that do Kristina knows fills in the missing piece for Kristina. Speaking with the close, informal "you" strips away any polite distance between them.
'He paid the price for mushroom rolls.' Kristina tells Max that he paid the price for mushroom rolls without dressing it up.
'Hello, Dmitry Vladimirovich.' With the guest and dish in play, Max keeps this short reply brisk and direct.
'Is that right?' Here asking whether that right shows Nagiyev looking for the real truth. In Russian, he does not need helper words like "do" or "did"—rising pitch alone turns it into a question.
Знали, что у нас с Кристиной проблемы.
'They found out that Kristina and I are having problems.' Kristina reminds Max that they found out that Kristina and she are having problems before the moment passes.
'Oh, what cunning people!' With the meat and work at stake, Max reacts without holding back. Russian puts the key word right up front so his emotion lands on the first beat.
'I mean, what creeps.' Nagiyev mentions that he means what creeps so Kristina sees what is at stake.
'That is what I am saying.' Kristina mentions that that is what she is saying so Max sees what is at stake.
'Have the guys get rid of him.' Claiming that have the guys get rid of him sounds confident, even if Kristina has doubts. Alright, let's hear the whole conversation once more from start to finish.
Гость в восторге от твоих вегетарианских рулетиков.
Ведь любое вегетарианское блюдо вкуснее с мясом.
Знали, что у нас с Кристиной проблемы.
That wraps up this scene as nastya tells Max that the vegetarian guest loved the rolls, while Nagiyev orders Senya and Fedya to scare off a paparazzo spying on him and Kristina. Until next time!
